method: Actual owned Pinia Notes stores, instrumented parentId accessors; sidebar-style root and child-presence lookups over 12 stores with 500 root pages each, repeated twice, then once after renaming a page in each store.
context: Deterministic getter field-access counts, not UI timing, heap measurements or a measured 50-app workload.
limits: Each store still owns separate editable page metadata and document state.
Indexing stores references to existing records, groups and sorted arrays; it does not bound metadata memory.
childrenOf still copies its matching result array, preserving the existing caller contract.
Membership, parent, ordering and trash changes can rebuild the index; sibling sorting still costs work.
Canonical shared metadata, persistence migrations and further caching are deferred pending representative foreground traces.
